card: Adds unit tests in coinselector_tests.cpp to cover SelectionResult::Merge algorithm propagation and SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees discounting. Existing unit tests missed these code paths, allowing mutations in coin selection algorithm reporting and fee discount deductions to survive. The author demonstrates that the tests kill two surviving mutants in src/wallet/coinselection.cpp.
changed_since_previous: Added a commit testing SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees before and after applying a bump fee discount in bump_fee_test.
evidence: PR description highlights two surviving mutants in src/wallet/coinselection.cpp: an inverted condition in SelectionResult::Merge leading to misreported algorithms, and an inverted sign on bump_fee_group_discount in SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees leading to wallet fee overpayment
problem: Neither the algorithm retention logic in SelectionResult::Merge nor the return value of SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees were directly exercised by unit tests, allowing potential regressions in selection reporting and bump fee calculation to pass CI undetected.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests in coinselector_tests.cpp.

summary: Adds unit test coverage for SelectionResult::Merge and SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees in the wallet test suite. It verifies that algorithm metadata is correctly tracked when merging manual preset inputs with automatic selection results, and that bump fee totals accurately account for group fee discounts.
